assumptions.local-symbolic: Predicate interpretations are explicit local hypotheses, not admitted KB facts; source references remain requests.
assumptions.trusted-implementation: Exact recorded compiler/std/dependency/frontend/kernel/projection bodies are trusted at runtime. Differential agreement is not refinement; output projection is not an untrusted certificate checker.
assumptions.finite-scope: Only the captured finite domain and complete admitted work/valuation/trace bounds are claimed. No larger KB inventory completeness follows.
assumptions.external-world: GroundedSound assumes EvidenceSound plus faithful acquisition, interpretation, assessment and exact closure. Real services and authorization remain WR1-WR8 blockers.
